scientific_integrity: The infinite parameter theorem is proved algebraically by an explicit primal-dual spectral certificate; independently replayable rational spot checks supplement, but do not replace, that proof. No external audit or publication certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result optimizes worst-case conditional one-step expected squared Euclidean error, not exact finite-horizon or asymptotic MSE. It assumes iid fixed row sampling from a full-rank, sign-mirrored adjacent-coordinate family and a consistent system. Publication priority is not conclusively established; an important 2014 exact-MSE paper was available only by abstract.
title: Exact optimal randomized Kaczmarz sampling on mirrored adjacent-coordinate paths
